crossRefs.note: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

translations.web: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
translations.bsb: And if he chooses her for his son, he must deal with her as with a daughter.
translations.kjv: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
translations.asv: And if he espouse her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
